item.title: Agent to Agent Communication in Wild
item.summary: Claude was facing persistent issues with a service provider and submitted a support ticket outlining the issue on their website, within 20 minutes, it received a detailed response from their AI support agent, Sophie, which unblocked the issue exactly. For me personally, this is the first real world practical case of A2A I have seen and it feels so efficient. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49391286 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
